name: Ritsuunkyo Sea of Clouds Viewpoint
description: The premier vantage point situated directly across the valley from Takeda Castle, offering breathtaking early-morning views of the 'Castle in the Sky' floating above a sea of clouds.
notes: Best sea of clouds occurs autumn mornings between 06:00 and 08:00.
notesJa: 【見どころ】雲海に浮かぶ竹田城跡を正面から望む「天空の城」絶景展望台です。
parkingJa: 【駐車場】登山口に有料駐車場あり。
openingHoursJa: 24時間開放（早朝登山がおすすめ）

editorial.editorialSummary: Premier vantage point facing Takeda Castle above early-morning clouds.
